ModMetaData.name: Taller Shelves
ModMetaData.author: Greg Stevenson
ModMetaData.description: Adds two new storage buildings, Tall Shelf and Tall Shelf (small): taller versions of the vanilla shelves that hold twice as much per cell. Unlocked with a new "Taller Shelving" research project.\n\nPure XML mod, no assemblies, safe to add/remove mid-save.
